tool_args.rationale: The prior attempt failed only because its code referenced undefined _FIT_ROWS. The eight available observations provide enough leverage to numerically fit gain, relaxation time, and equilibrium coefficient for the recalled normalized before/after contrast mechanism; this implementation fits supplied rows directly and exposes a prediction function using the fitted parameters.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its three added opposing-step/horizon rows supplement the original five, so another batch is not justified before fitting.
It is explicitly nuisance/high-variance and does not discriminate the normalized contrast law.
Its prediction depends on x_now and H but does not explain the systematic opposing-step sign contrast as directly as the recalled normalized before/after mechanism.
It lacks the recalled equilibrium contribution; compare against the three-parameter normalized contrast law using numerical fitting.
